name: Mercedes-Benz
description: Mercedes-Benz over a generic OBD-II dongle. Engine (0x7E0/0x7E8) + automatic transmission (0x7E1/0x7E9) deep read plus generic OBD-II, on 11-bit/500k CAN -- honestly the whole reachable set. Body/chassis/comfort modules (ABS/ESP, SRS, SAM, EZS, cluster, Airmatic, Parktronic, climate) use Mercedes' proprietary addressing behind a filtering gateway and are STAR/XENTRY-only -- no OBD dongle reaches them. Works ~2004-2018 (petrol OBD ~2001+, EU diesel ~2004+); ~2018+ cars are DoIP/Ethernet and give generic OBD-II only. This is NOT a VCDS/ISTA-style all-modules walk.

panel.title: Engine & gearbox deep read (OBD dongle)
panel.hint: Reads the engine and automatic gearbox fault memory + identification deeper than generic OBD-II, plus the VIN and a generic all-system scan. Works on mainstream Mercedes ~2004-2018 (petrol OBD ~2001+, EU diesel ~2004+). Body modules (ABS/ESP, SRS, SAM, EZS, cluster, Airmatic, climate) are STAR/XENTRY-only on ANY dongle -- their ids live in encrypted CBF files, so apps like Carly use privately reverse-engineered maps the dongle itself can't supply. On ~2018+ cars full diagnostics moved to DoIP/Ethernet, so only generic OBD-II answers -- the scan says so rather than imply a fault. Pick the adapter top-right, ignition ON, then scan.

actions.label: Live extras
actions.title: Mercedes live extras
actions.hint: Reads the one verified Mercedes-specific value the generic list doesn't carry -- 722.9/9G automatic-transmission (ATF) oil temperature on the gearbox ECU -- plus a curated generic Mode-01 set (coolant, oil temp, module voltage, ambient, fuel level). DPF soot / AdBlue level have no public DID for Mercedes, so DPF/SCR health shows through the fault codes instead.
